issues.description: Method Stock.add(String): The UML in problem_statement.md declares Stock.add(String) with return type void, while both the template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) and the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) implement public int add(String). This inconsistency between the problem specification and the provided code can confuse students about the expected signature and return value of Stock.add and which behavior to implement or rely on in tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent with the code. Update the UML and any textual references in problem_statement.md to declare add(String): int (i.e., +add(String): int) so it matches the template and solution. Alternatively, if the pedagogical intent was to have void, change the template and solution implementations to a void signature and update their logic accordingly. Prefer updating the UML to add(String): int to avoid changing working code and tests.
